No daily front door

New people only find you when you post

Your classes are ready to sell, but the people who discover them are the ones who happened to see today’s content. Nothing introduces Human Design Lady to new people every day.

No bridge

A $33.33 buyer has no clear next step

Nothing sits between a recorded masterclass and Teacher Training that shows who wants to go all the way, so serious future teachers and casual chart-readers land in the same place.

Launch-led

Revenue moves when you announce something

Masterminds, immersions and live classes sell when you launch them. Between launches, sales depend on the scroll, and that is capped by how much you can create.

Your catalogue only reaches people who see today’s post, and nothing tells you which of them are ready for Teacher Training.
